limitations: Injection-series identity INFERRED: the 11 'S22041-fraction-N.raw' files carry the instrument-internal name 'S22043-fraction-N' (D:\2022-Jul-26), while 'S22041-2ndrun-N.raw' carry 'S22041-2ndrun-N' (D:\2022-Sep-29). The deposit, the combined PEAKS search ('S22041 1+2batches ... 1st+2nd light and heavy') and the paper (6 samples, six TMT channels) are consistent with both series being injections of the same TMT mix, so both are annotated with the same 6 source names as technical replicates 1 and 2. No source states this explicitly; if 'S22043' was a separately labelled mix the source names of technical replicate 1 would need new names.

TMT channel naming: the paper says the TMT10plex kit (Thermo #90110) was used, but the analysis and Fig. 1E name the six channels TMT6-126..131 and the search uses TMT6plex masses. Labels are written as the TMT6 channels TMT126-TMT131 (PRIDE:0000516..0000529). Which 10plex reagent (e.g. 127N vs 127C) was used for each is not documented; no MS3 reporter spectra could be read (MGFs hold ion-trap MS2 only; no Thermo raw reader available).

Channel map cross-check against deposited data was not possible: the deposit holds no quantitative table (mzid has identifications only). The map rests on Fig. 1E's explicit column annotation; its z-scores for TFRC/SLC3A2/ACSL4/CBS (reported zotatifin-induced, confirmed by immunoblot Fig. 1F) are consistent with 129-131 = zotatifin.

Pulsed SILAC within TMT: each TMT channel carries both the pre-existing (light) and newly synthesised (heavy, last 8 h) proteome of one culture; per the community precedent for pSILAC-TMT (sdrf-annotated-datasets PXD073468, PXD004725) rows are per (file x TMT channel) and the heavy Lys8/Arg10 labels appear as variable modifications.

Paper/PRIDE conflicts resolved by raw files: instrument (paper 'Orbitrap Exploris 240' vs raw/PRIDE 'Orbitrap Fusion Lumos'); MS1 scan range (PRIDE 550-1800 vs raw 400-1700); gradient (PRIDE '60 min gradient' vs raw method duration 120 min). PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol says 'polysome lysis buffer', the paper says 'UREA lysis buffer' — not annotated.
Search details not expressible in columns: semi-specific trypsin, 3 missed cleavages, PEAKS Studio 10.6 (dataProcessingProtocol says PEAKS X+ v10.5), 5% FDR project filter.

Reduction and alkylation reagents not stated ('Samples were reduced, alkylated') -> not available; Carbamidomethyl C fixed is taken from the search. Passage number, storage temperature, individual and cell type not stated -> not available.
Treatment dose (12.5 nM zotatifin) and the DMSO vehicle are not in columns (no dose/compound column licensed by the declared templates); DMSO vehicle encoded as 'untreated' per campaign rule 4.

Supplementary tables (NIHMS2102785-supplement-9..13.xlsx) could not be read: PMC served a reCAPTCHA page; Europe PMC supplementaryFiles answers 'Article with id PMC12363560 is not open access one' (Europe PMC search on PXD055896: 1 hit, this paper; no dataset descriptor). Not bypassed.
